name: view-3d
title: 3D viewer
description: A small orthographic 3D viewer in SVG: drag or use the arrow keys to rotate vectors, lines and plane patches.

yaw.description: Starting rotation about the vertical axis, in radians (a view's own yaw overrides it).

pitch.description: Starting tilt towards the viewer, in radians (a view's own pitch overrides it).

pitchLimit.description: Largest tilt either way, in radians, so the view never flips over (π/2 ≈ 1.57 is straight down).

dragSpeed.description: Radians of rotation per pixel dragged.

keyStep.description: Radians per arrow-key press (Shift + arrow = four times this).

keyboard.description: Make each viewer focusable and rotatable with the arrow keys (Home resets the view).

label.default: 3D view. Drag, or focus and use the arrow keys, to rotate. Home resets.
label.description: aria-label given to viewers that have none of their own.

axisNames.description: Labels V.axes() writes at the positive ends of the three axes.

arrowHead.description: Maximum arrow-head length in SVG units.
